subject: Web Development
title: The Dynamic HTML Era
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Dynamic HTML Era usable.

hook.text: In the late 90s, JavaScript could change page content after it loaded. This was revolutionary.

buildup.text: Dynamic HTML combined JavaScript, CSS, and the DOM to create interactive effects.

discovery.text: Dropdown menus, image rollovers, and scrolling tickers became the hallmarks of 'cool' sites.

twist.text: Netscape and IE implemented DHTML differently. Code that worked in one browser crashed the other.

climax.text: DHTML showed JavaScript's potential but also its biggest weakness: browser fragmentation.

quiz.question: What was DHTML a combination of?
